description: Fetches GST registration details, taxpayer profile, and return filing history directly from the Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN). Used to verify the GST compliance status of businesses, validate GSTIN, check declared annual turnover, and assess business legitimacy for business loan underwriting. Commonly used in MSME and SME lending to verify that a business is GST-registered, actively filing returns, and not in a cancelled or suspended state.
use_cases: GSTIN validation for business loan applicants
Business legitimacy check before MSME loan disbursal
Turnover band verification for credit limit setting
Tax compliance screening for business onboarding
Supply chain financing and invoice discounting verification
Cash flow assessment using GST turnover data
compliance_context: Government of India GSTN API. Data access requires registered API access from GSTN. Business consent or power of attorney required for third-party fetches.
typical_callers: MSME lenders, SME banks, invoice financing platforms, supply chain finance platforms, business onboarding teams
auth_description: API Key authentication using a GSTN-issued key passed in the request header.

versions.release_notes: Beta with dynamic JSON and lower latency

required_fields.description: 15-character GST Identification Number of the business
Financial year for which return data is requested
Type of GST return to retrieve

optional_fields.description: Specific month or quarter of the return filing
Whether to include amendment filings in the response

error_codes.400: Invalid GSTIN format or financial year.
